run_pca_pipeline: run the pca builder pipeline to compute paper author and institution PCA features from raw BERT features
build_pca_principal_components: build principal components by sampling paper features and computing SVD on the covariance matrix
project_features_onto_pca: project high-dimensional paper features onto principal components in memory-efficient blocks
compute_author_pca_features: compute author PCA features by aggregating paper PCA features using author-paper index arrays
compute_institution_pca_features: compute institution PCA features by aggregating author PCA features using institution-author index arrays
